summary: Nuvve Holding Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a September 26, 2026 repricing of outstanding Additional AIR Warrants issued under its October 31, 2024 securities purchase agreement with accredited investors. Per Section 2(h), the company cut the exercise price to $1.00 and removed the floor price for the remaining term; investors then exercised 253,954 warrants for 253,954 common shares, generating roughly $253,954 gross proceeds. Resale shares are covered by an effective Form S-1 (File No. 333-292624). This is a routine financing/warrant amendment, not a special situation; watch dilution and any further warrant exercises.
